author: PokerFace
body:
When are the matches! There is still no set time, only a set day and even then, the day is not specific as Saturday in America can be Sunday in Australlia. There is only a little more than a week left and, I would like to plan things around the tournament to avoid conflict. At the very least, it should've been released 2 weeks in advance. So please... I hope the information comes out soon.

Thanks.
-PokerFace
